definitions.explanation: The quality or degree to which a substance is poisonous or harmful to living organisms.

examples.japanese: この{植物|しょくぶつ}には{毒性|どくせい}がある。
{毒性|どくせい}の{強|つよ}い{化学物質|かがくぶっしつ}は{厳|きび}しく{管理|かんり}されている。
examples.english: Highly toxic chemicals are strictly controlled.

examples.japanese: このキノコの{毒性|どくせい}について{詳|くわ}しく{調|しら}べる{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to investigate the toxicity of this mushroom in detail.

notes:
Composed of {毒|どく} (poison) + {性|せい} (nature/property). Refers to the inherent toxic quality of a substance rather than the poison itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毒性|どくせい}がある — to be toxic
- {毒性|どくせい}が{強|つよ}い — highly toxic
- {毒性|どくせい}が{弱|よわ}い — mildly toxic
- {毒性|どくせい}{試験|しけん} — toxicity test
- {毒性|どくせい}{物質|ぶっしつ} — toxic substance
- {急性|きゅうせい}{毒性|どくせい} — acute toxicity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {有毒|ゆうどく} — poisonous, toxic (adjective-like; describes that something has poison)
- {毒|どく} — poison (the substance itself)
- {有害|ゆうがい} — harmful (broader; includes things that aren't specifically poisonous)
- {危険性|きけんせい} — dangerousness (broader concept of risk)
